description: This file is part of a build setup for gcc targeting cross-compilation, written in a mix of shell script and Bitbake recipe syntax. It defines configuration options, package lists, installation procedures, and build logic for cross-compiled gcc.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the gcc cross-compiler, configuring build options, modifying configuration headers, and building all components.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled gcc, cleans up unnecessary files, creates necessary symlinks, and sets permissions.

methods.name: do_install:append
methods.description: Post-installation cleanup to prune include-fixed headers except under include-fixed/linux, limits.h, and README.
